title: New CFE Substation in Nuevo Laredo to Serve More Than 31,000 Users
excerpt: A new CFE power substation in Nuevo Laredo’s Ciudad Deportiva sector began operating Oct. 31 after seven months of construction, with a 10-megavolt-ampere transformer and an 84-million-peso investment.
content:
The Federal Electricity Commission (CFE) has begun operating a new power substation in Nuevo Laredo’s Ciudad Deportiva sector, designed to strengthen the local distribution network and expand power supply for more than 31,000 residential, commercial and industrial users, according to Central de Noticias Tamaulipas, citing a CFE statement.

The Subestación de Potencia Unidad Deportiva formally entered service Oct. 31, 2026, after seven months of construction and equipment installation, according to the report.

The project represents an 84-million-peso investment and includes a 10-megavolt-ampere (MVA) power transformer, sized for current needs and the city’s future growth, according to the report.

The new infrastructure lets the utility redistribute loads across the local grid, improving supply reliability, response to demand peaks and the feasibility of new housing, commercial and industrial developments, according to the report.

CFE noted that strengthening the power grid is key to sustaining the logistics, industrial and service activity that makes Nuevo Laredo one of Mexico’s main commercial crossings, according to the report.

Source: Central de Noticias Tamaulipas, November 16, 2026.
